title: Per-User rate limit on finance requests
shows: A fresh User sending finance requests in a burst is refused with HTTP 429 and Retry-After once the 120-per-minute window is used up.
limits: Counters live in one server's memory. On serverless hosting the limit is per instance, not global, and there is no per-IP limit.

checks.label: Refusals tell the client when to retry
Every later request in the window is refused
